person_reference.depiction: 右側に低いドリブル姿の手描きイラスト1人。無地のえんじ色ウェア。一般的な動作のイメージで、特定の実戦場面の再現ではない。

brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape approximately 16:9, target 1792 x 1008 pixels. This is a new editorial illustration, not a photograph.

Content authority: the supplied fixed article is dated 2026-11-06 and describes PRE-GAME selection of registered players by current season average EFF. Participation is not confirmed. Results are not final. It is not a report of a particular player's performance. Only the exact text below may appear.

Art direction: approved バスケまとめ style: charcoal black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm off-white typography, expressive rough hand-drawn ink and dry-brush hatching, restrained composition. Reference visual direction is the black/lime Culver thumbnail already viewed; use its ink style, NOT its person, name, date, score or numbers. Two or three broad energetic diagonal brush marks, little visual clutter. A sophisticated sports editorial print, clearly illustrated, never photorealistic.

Subject: exactly one real basketball player, Tatsuya Suzuki / 鈴木達也, selected randomly from the people named in the article. His identity is a visual reference only. Do NOT write his name, number, team, statistics, achievements, or any claim that he will play. Use the official 2026-27 profile visually inspected at https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=8568 and portrait https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/719/2026-27/8568_03.png . Likeness details from the portrait: adult Japanese male, compact lean athletic guard build, straight black hair with loose center/off-center part and short sides, strands descending at the temples, long oval face tapering to a small pointed chin, narrow almond-shaped eyes, straight dark brows, prominent ears, straight nose, a small sparse dark goatee on the tip and underside of his chin, no full beard, no thick mustache. Keep the face recognizable in ink illustration, with clear light facial planes rather than crushed black shadows. The official portrait is for identity reference only; do not paste, trace, or reproduce the photographic pose or logos.

Pose/composition: dynamic low dribble drive, bent knees and torso leaning forward, shown from head to below the knees, face in a three-quarter view looking alertly toward the open court to the left. Place the player on the right 40 percent, within margins. One hand controlling an orange basketball near knee height, the other arm naturally counterbalancing. Anatomically plausible two arms and hands, no fused fingers or extra limbs. The entire ball, head, and both hands must fit inside the image. Uniform is a plain sleeveless dark oxblood jersey with simple off-white edging, no letters, numerals, team marks, brand marks or sponsor logos. The ball is a player-held/dribbled prop, not the primary subject. Abstract brush-mark background, no scoreboard, crowd, other players or depictions of an identifiable actual game.

Typography/layout: left 58 percent, huge bold Japanese gothic headlines, exact readable characters, clean separation from the player's face, deliberate negative space, safe outer margins at least 65 pixels. The title dominates at thumbnail scale.
Exact text, and no other text:
small top brand: "バスケまとめ"
date/status beneath it: "2026.11.06｜試合前"
medium-large line: "今季平均EFF"
supporting line: "登録選手の"
main oversized lime headline: "ベスト5"
clear caveat below the headline, legible off-white: "出場確定ではありません"
bottom footer, clearly legible: "イラスト（AI生成）"
footer next to that: "イメージ"

No player name, no team name, no jersey number, no individual numerical stat, no scores, no win/loss claims, no official league logo or club logo, no photographic inserts, no watermark. This is a general imagined basketball movement, never a recreation of a verified game moment. Only the article-level information is in the headline. Preserve the pre-game / season-average qualifiers exactly.
